latHint: Think spotless, like a freshly scrubbed kitchen.
pivHint: In watercolor, a WASH is a thin, see-through layer of paint. In the sink, to WASH something is to make it ______.
winText: Squeaky. WASH was the pivot - a thin layer of watercolor to making things CLEAN.
lossText: CLEAN - free of dirt. WASH was the pivot: a WASH is a thin layer of watercolor paint, but to WASH dishes or clothes is to make them CLEAN.
